title: With 12 years as a Ray, Series berth just means more for Jonathan Aranda
text:
With 12 years as a Ray, Series berth just means more for Jonathan Aranda

 With 12 years as a Ray, Series berth just means more for Jonathan Aranda
 There is a lot of happiness and pride for the slugging first baseman who signed as a teenager in 2015.     .   Jonathan Aranda, who joined the Rays organization at 17, on his longevity with the franchise: “It’s a great thing. It’s not easy to be a major-leaguer and be with an organization for an extremely long time. It’s something I take a lot of pride in." [ LUIS SANTANA | Times ] Marc Topkin is a sports reporter covering the Tampa Bay Rays. Reach him at mtopkin@tampabay.com.
